g.text: run: preflight, the class side, the jail, reap
resolve the class, compute the grant
the image ID (the container starts by ID, never by tag)
container and network list/remove for resources
whose owning pid is dead (never by profile prefix alone)
The same verification function doctor --network calls. A network that
changed under you fails before anything starts, and a refusal is not a
start on the class and egress networks
An empty grant is announced ("this jail has no route out"), not refused:
the gateway is started with --grant "" and permits nothing. The audit
directory is created and pruned to the newest 20 runs per class before the
read the gateway's address on the class network
the address, or the exit code it exited with (reported as its
refusal), or no address after 15s: the run is refused
run --rm --interactive jail on the class network
start with fd 0/1/2 as pipes, no TTY
CONNECT host:port, the jail has no other peer
forward each signal to podman, then wait
tini, which forwards it to the agent
grandchildren of the agent are not signalled:
tini forwards to its direct child only
remove the gateway, then the egress network,
then the class network, on every exit path
exit with the agent's own code
